ضُبَاضِبٌ : see the next preceding paragraph, in two places. Also, applied to a man, Strong;
(IDrd, O, K;) and so بُضَابِضٌ: (IDrd, O:) or short, and very foul or obscene: or hard, or hardy, and strong: (K:) and sometimes applied as an epithet to a camel. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
